What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[BB-8 (Beebee-Ate)]]: left, the image of [[BB-8 (Beebee-Ate) (Errata)]] (holotable commit e8445f0); right, the image of [[BB-8 (Beebee-Ate) (Errata 2)]] (holotable commit 12d0bca). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/bb8.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/bb8.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
